source.title: Some open problems in topological algebras

trace.notes: Normalized the input as a zbMATH bibliographic resolver URL with trailing identifier 3622421.

Direct local fetch of https://zbmath.org/3622421 returned an HTTP 403 Cloudflare challenge. Local shell fetches of api.zbmath.org failed with DNS resolution errors, so the resolver could not be read directly.

Local workflow shard metadata for the same zbMATH identifier records the title as 'Some open problems in topological algebras' and the year as 1978. A PASCAL/INIST bibliographic record for the same title identifies the author as W. Zelazko and the source as a 1978 conference paper, pages 258-264, but provides no readable full text.

Ran exact-work recovery attempts using the zbMATH identifier, exact title, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus author, and exact title plus conference/year. Recovered candidates were rejected because they were different works, including the 2012 'Some Open Problems in Topological Algebra' by Banakh, Choban, Guran, and Protasov and the 1982 'Some open problems in the theory of topological algebras' by M. Abal, or because they were metadata-only records, seminar abstracts, bibliographies, search snippets, or previews without the 1978 problem statements.

No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the 1978 technical problem statements was recovered within the bounded pass. The workflow forbids extracting questions from resolver metadata, bibliographic records, abstracts, search snippets, or different works.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-3622421.json and outputs/latest.json.
